# Printed days of the Vishwavidyalaya Panchang (Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga
# Sanskrit University, Darbhanga), the Mithila almanac made from the
# Makarandasarini on the Surya Siddhanta. Its front matter (2022-23) states
# the place every Mithila panchang is computed for: longitude 85°30′ E,
# latitude 26°35′ N, palabha 6 angula. Read from the scans in the Internet
# Archive item `vishwavidyalaya-panchang`, one fortnight a year; every end
# was checked against the clock time the page prints beside it, and an end
# whose figure and clock disagree is written ?|? rather than guessed.
#
# Columns: civil date; the row's tithi (1 to 30, krishna pratipada = 16);
# its end in ghati|pala after sunrise (60|00: none that day); the row's
# nakshatra (1 = Ashvini); its end; the printed day length (dinamana).
# Read by crates/siddhanta/tests/mithila.rs (docs/03-design/makaranda.md).
